description: The CERTH-HIT OpenData Hub publishes 20 traffic datasets for Thessaloniki and selected Greek paths from the Hellenic Institute of Transport. Floating car data are used to estimate current speeds and congestion levels (low, medium or high) on the links of an OpenStreetMap-based base network of Thessaloniki, and travel times on predefined paths. iTravel roadside detection devices add detection counts, hourly trajectories between devices and travel times, and a data fusion product combines both sources. Historical archives exist for speeds, travel times, trajectories and floating car positions, alongside a 2012 emissions shapefile and estimated daily bus vehicle-kilometres by route. Coverage is the greater Thessaloniki area and selected paths in Greece. Access: free real-time feeds in JSON, XML and CSV (paged at 500 records) and historical text files; the dataset is also listed on the Greek national access point and data.europa.eu; licence terms are referred to the hub's about page. Caveats: the congestion feed gives only three classes, some catalogue entries were last updated in 2023, and coverage depends on the probe fleet. It supports traffic state estimation, calibration of urban traffic models, real-time digital twins and disruption impact studies.
